description.value: Sizzling Wok is a Chinese fast-food counter located inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre, Kelowna's large enclosed mall on the Harvey Avenue corridor. It specialises in a 'pick your own combo' format, letting customers choose a base of rice or noodles and then select from dishes such as sesame chicken, BBQ pork, sweet and sour pork, and a variety of vegetables. For cyclists riding through the Harvey Avenue commercial strip, it offers a quick and filling hot meal in a sheltered indoor setting.
